name: main-ask
//: A project's first build asks for its main file: a strip over the pages, PhiTeX's pick preselected, until answered (picked, or 'Yes, build it'), then kept for the project and not asked again. A build that stops before a page offers another main file on its card. One .tex file: nothing asked.

steps.what: asked: the strip, the pick preselected, the .tex files to pick from
steps.check: (() => { const r = document.querySelector('phitex-preview').shadowRoot; const s = r.querySelector('#mainask select'); return [s.value, [...s.options].map((o) => o.value).sort(), r.querySelector('#mainask .keep').textContent]; })()

steps.what: answered: the strip gone, the choice kept for the project
a project with its main file chosen: not asked again
the build stopped before a page: another main file offered, the one built selected

steps.eval: (() => { const s = document.querySelector('phitex-preview').shadowRoot.querySelector('#empty .card .mainrow select'); s.value = 'main.tex'; s.dispatchEvent(new Event('change')); })()

steps.what: main.tex picked on the card: its first page, and kept
steps.check: new Promise((ok) => { const t0 = Date.now(); const f = () => document.querySelector('phitex-preview')?.shadowRoot?.querySelector('.slot svg.page, .slot canvas') ? chrome.storage.local.get('mains').then(({ mains }) => ok(mains['/project/mock'])) : Date.now() - t0 > 60000 ? ok('no page in 60 s') : setTimeout(f, 250); f(); })
